claims.statement: R(t) <= 1 for every real t in [-1,0].
For c >= 48/35, every fresh negative-half biased activation tower over a Boolean base P satisfying U(P) <= c I(P) has U(F_d) <= c I(F_d) at every finite depth.
claims.scope: Fresh disjoint blocks; fair selectors; fixed two-bit balancer of mean -1/2; endpoint-valid base. The constant is sufficient, not certified optimal.

claims.statement: For any finite adaptive or pruned physical-variable restriction tree and one common disjoint Boolean core h, the root-minus-leaves U payment is at most c I(F_d).
claims.scope: Endpoint telescope only; no nodewise positivity, restriction closure, changing/leaf-dependent core, or shared-variable conclusion.

claims.statement: The three reviewed B05 v1 claims are independently accepted exactly at the stated scope; the arbitrary changing-core hierarchy and full FEI remain open.
